# libdwarf / fuzz_set_frame_all

libdwarf's own fuzz target `fuzz_set_frame_all` ([source](source/fuzz_set_frame_all.c), unmodified), one of the targets OSS-Fuzz builds, over libdwarf-code (davea42/libdwarf-code at aecc146e).

For each of 5 frame-rule setters x {SHRT_MIN, SHRT_MAX, 0}: reads .debug_frame and .eh_frame, every CIE/FDE, selected register rules, the full register table and expanded frame instructions, printing everything. The 'Compiler or libdwarf botch' and 'Internal error in libdwarf' lines are printf only.

## How this program differs from what OSS-Fuzz runs
- Linked against libdwarf-code at commit aecc146e.
- In every build, getenv() returns NULL, getpid() returns 1 and mkstemp() uses a fixed name, so the program depends only on its input.
- A small driver reads the input file, calls the harness one to four times and prints each return value.

## What the harness checks
The harness makes no check of its own beyond not crashing, so a statement about it says only that the code it calls never crashes, hangs or trips a sanitizer.

## Builds
Static riscv64 Linux programs, compiled for RV64G and run as `<file> <input-file>`; `oft fetch libdwarf` downloads the published ones and checks each against its SHA-256.

| build | file | bytes | sha256 |
|---|---|---:|---|
| plain | `fuzz_set_frame_all.plain` | 431,064 | `98a60c7a3b37632f84d990116b4c2774d6027b77083f492be60a8bce6c1ab2db` |
| ubsan | `fuzz_set_frame_all.ubsan` | 446,168 | `90eb0c825ebd50aed1d863a2423fbcd2b18a86657dd5d2924f767d48f7aacc27` |
| asan | `fuzz_set_frame_all.asan` | 1,201,496 | `27341e9cf308b94da3900e376bdd9a635bf6ed41b018d943457002e3b04c386b` |
| asan-ubsan | `fuzz_set_frame_all.asan-ubsan` | 1,210,936 | `b7af6103c319081a1009300f9eea61d911a1ab196c1f7651b266f87abe79e6b1` |

Each build also links code that no sanitizer instruments, as its link recorded it. A statement about a sanitizer build covers that code only as uninstrumented code: ASan checks no load or store made inside it, and UBSan inserts no check there.

- plain: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libz.a` (a library from the build image), `libzstd.a` (a library from the build image)
- ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libz.a` (a library from the build image), `libzstd.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image), `libzstd.a` (a library from the build image)
- asan-ubsan: `clang_rt.crtbegin.o` (compiler-rt), `libclang_rt.asan.a` (the sanitizer runtime), `libclang_rt.builtins.a` (compiler-rt), `crt1.o` (the C library), `libc.a` (the C library), `libunwind.a` (the C++ runtime), `libz.a` (a library from the build image), `libzstd.a` (a library from the build image)
